Win in [[Heroes' Ascent]].

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Win 2 battles in Heroes' Ascent.
* *BONUS* Win your way to competing in the [[The Hall of Heroes (arena)|Hall of Heroes]].
* *BONUS* Win 6 battles in Heroes' Ascent.
* See [[Zehnchu]] <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen]] Challenge] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 1,500 [[Gold]]
* 9,000 [[Balthazar Faction]]
* Complete the Base Objective for 50 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coins]].
* Complete the first *BONUS* Objective for an additional 100 Zaishen Copper Coins.
* Complete the second *BONUS* Objective for an additional 200 Zaishen Copper Coins.

==Walkthrough==
Form a [[party]] of eight along with seven player characters and/or henchmen in the Heroes' Ascent outpost. Check out possible [[meta]] [[build]]s on  [http://www.gwpvx.com/Category:Meta_working_HA_builds PvXwiki].

==Dialogues==
===Initial dialogue===
;Zaishen Combat
:''"The most favored of [[Balthazar]] may make the Heroes' Ascent. Build your team of eight and prepare for battle. Win at least two battles before you return to Zehnchu."''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = I can do that!
| decline = No, I'm way too busy today.
| ask = More competitors needed to prove their mettle in combat. Travel to the battlegrounds if you have what it takes to triumph.
}}

===Reward dialogue===
;Zehnchu
:''"Excellent work! The Zaishen admire your dedication."''
